nodes.label: Livewire Module Index
nodes.rationale: Livewire 4 packages provide interactive state and views over exactly one matching core package; they validate and authorize at the boundary and delegate mutations rather than owning them.

nodes.label: Liberu MyMemory Translation
nodes.rationale: Ships as an optional cached adapter in the `adapter` category so the host can add machine translation without the core localization package depending on a third-party service.

nodes.label: Liberu Module Manager
nodes.rationale: Owns manifest discovery, dependency resolution, deployment enablement, registry caching and diagnostics for the whole composition, so enablement is a decision the manager resolves rather than a side effect of Composer install.

nodes.label: Real Estate Core
nodes.rationale: Owns the real-estate operational boundaries the shared organizations module does not own - team-scoped branches and stable branch codes - and stays presentation-neutral, passing explicit team context at every mutation boundary.

nodes.label: liberu-module Composer Package Type
nodes.rationale: Every module declares Composer type `liberu-module`; the type is what makes the package discoverable to the host's module manager and theme/module discovery rather than to Laravel's provider auto-discovery.

nodes.label: liberusoftware/composer-installer
nodes.rationale: A trusted Composer installer places each package under /modules/<installer-name>. The installed directory stays tracked by the host repository while Composer and its lock file remain the source of version truth.

nodes.label: Installation Does Not Imply Enablement
nodes.rationale: Every module README states that installation implies neither runtime enablement nor commercial entitlement, so adding a package to the composition is a separate decision from booting it.

nodes.label: Enabled By Default Declaration
nodes.rationale: All ten templated module READMEs in this chunk declare `Enabled by default: no`, including foundation packages such as module-manager, localization, notifications, observability, organizations-teams and profiles. The host CLAUDE.md instead states 37 of 40 manifests set default_enabled true, so README and manifest may disagree - flagged for review.

nodes.label: Capability Declaration
nodes.rationale: Each package exports named capabilities (e.g. foundation.modules, identity.profiles) that hosts and dependent modules bind to, instead of coupling to application-specific classes.

nodes.label: Manifest Service Provider
nodes.rationale: Each manifest names one service provider class under the Liberu\Foundation namespace; the host registers it explicitly rather than through extra.laravel.providers auto-discovery.

nodes.label: Declared Public Boundary
nodes.rationale: Hosts integrate a package through its declared provider, capabilities and published contracts; consumers must not couple to internal tables or classes, and authorization stays the host's responsibility unless a public authorizer contract is published.

nodes.label: Standalone Package Test Suite
nodes.rationale: Every package ships its own tests, run from a compatible host checkout as `vendor/bin/pest modules/<name>/tests`; changes must preserve the manifest, provider integration, package boundaries and declared PHP/Laravel compatibility.

nodes.label: Team-Scoped Boundary
nodes.rationale: Real-estate transports and domain records are scoped to a team and pass explicit team context at every mutation boundary; unauthorized cross-team access surfaces as 403 Forbidden rather than a silently filtered result.

nodes.label: Presentation-Neutral Core Package
nodes.rationale: A domain core package owns rules and persistence but no UI, so Filament, Livewire and API adapters can be added, swapped or omitted without touching domain behaviour.

nodes.label: Adapter Over One Matching Core Package
nodes.rationale: Each -api, -filament and -livewire package adapts exactly one matching core package: it validates and authorizes at the boundary and delegates mutations to the core rather than reimplementing them.

nodes.label: Unprefixed Composer Name vs module- GitHub Repository
nodes.rationale: The published Composer/Packagist name drops the `module-` prefix carried by the GitHub source repository, so liberusoftware/real-estate-instructions on Composer is module-real-estate-instructions on GitHub.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key Header
nodes.rationale: Replays a completed mutation for the same team, key and request body (8-255 chars), so a retried POST/PATCH/DELETE cannot double-apply; a mismatch returns 409 Conflict.

nodes.label: 429 RateLimited Response
nodes.rationale: Every instructions operation declares a 429 response carrying a Retry-After header, making rate limiting part of the published contract rather than an undocumented gateway behaviour.

nodes.label: Instruction Record
nodes.rationale: Team-scoped agency instruction covering agreements, ownership checks, terms, disclosures, approvals and withdrawal.

nodes.label: Instruction Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: draft, pending_approval, approved, withdrawn, rejected - with approved_at and withdrawn_at timestamps; delete archives rather than destroys (204 Instruction archived).

nodes.label: Letting Lifecycle Capabilities
nodes.rationale: Applications, referencing, deposits, agreements, move-in/out, renewals, rent changes and notices, each an explicit lifecycle capability on a team-scoped letting record.

nodes.label: Archive Instead of Destroy on DELETE
nodes.rationale: DELETE returns 204 with the description 'archived' for branches, agencies, territories and instructions, so the transport contract never promises hard deletion.

nodes.label: liberusoftware/localization-contracts
nodes.rationale: A separate contracts package lets localization-mymemory adapt a third-party translation service while the core localization package depends only on the contract, keeping the adapter's implementation independent.

nodes.label: ObservabilityActor Contract
nodes.rationale: Published so the host User model can gate Telescope and Pulse dashboards without the observability module knowing about App\Models\User.

nodes.label: Shared users Table Extension
nodes.rationale: Profiles adds locale, theme_preference and timezone columns to the host-owned users table via three migrations - the users table is the one table no package owns.

nodes.label: Teams, Membership and Invitation Tables
nodes.rationale: teams, team_user and team_invitations plus a 2026 hardening migration; these tables are the substrate the whole composition's tenant scoping resolves against.

nodes.label: module:features Console Command
nodes.rationale: Lists or searches feature declarations across installed modules, making the fleet's declared features queryable from one place.
